description: Minified wrapper for the xz-packed fx2-cmix binary plus cmix-compressed english.dic payload
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Compression behavior should match fx2cmix_wrapped_dictcmix_xz_v1 byte-for-byte; this variant only reduces the scored Python wrapper bytes.

100m_inherited_from_fx2cmix_wrapped_dict.roundtrip_basis: Same decompressed native binary, byte-identical decoded dictionary, same -c/-d dictionary arguments, and byte-identical 1KB archive output.

verdict: Promote as a packaging-only improvement over fx2cmix_wrapped_dictcmix_xz_v1.
